name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday "Jolly Holiday Combo" Toasted Cheese & Tomato Soup
whyItWorks: Disneyland's signature rainy-day comfort meal! Melted cheddar and Swiss cheeses griddled on sourdough bread, paired with smooth, creamy tomato basil soup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Jolly Holiday Combo; dip the warm grilled cheese into the smooth tomato soup.
watchOuts: Tomato soup has mild acidity; enjoy in moderation if acid-sensitive
